coefficient_identity: E1Pred1 explicitly copied E1D1 actual/fixed_alpha. Frozen JSON equals Pred1 scalar table. CSV parse/serialization changes 10 of 81 last-bit values relative to D1 decimals; preserve both exact coefficient families.
donor_rule: Same class/cell, distinct locked seed; FP64 norm-match then FP32 direction
finite_difference: Central fixed_alpha response; half-alpha is QC, not primary
isotropic_aggregation: arithmetic mean of separately computed LCG_iso0 and LCG_iso1
scalar_aggregation: FP64 ratio-of-sums: sum ||v||^2 / sum ||u||^2 over V_c
support_rule: intersection of tangent-valid actual, isotropic_0, isotropic_1, and seed_shuffled pairs within each cell
verification_scope: Read-only source commit/blob, scalar norm table and metadata audit; not raw tensor, model or tangent-validity reproduction
